kos.name: Γ — sheaf convergence
kos.definition: The sheaf convergence measure **Γ** (gamma) tracks the inverse: how well local sections glue into a globally consistent picture.

kos.name: Ψ — narrative self-reference ratio
kos.definition: **Ψ** (psi) is the *psychosis metric* — the ratio of narrative self-reference to reality-contact.
kos.note: Introduced as "psychosis metric"; that label is retired in thesis v4.4. Current reading: "In the Draken framework, Ψ is the Narrative Self-Reference Ratio" (The Substrate and the Game, DRK-130).

kos.name: K(t) — coherence debt
kos.definition: *This article introduces the coherence debt function K(t) — the temporal integral of excess Ψ above viable threshold — and argues that what spiritual traditions have called karma, what systems theorists have called fragility, and what the Draken framework diagnoses as civilizational Ψ-degradation are structurally identical phenomena: the accumulated cost of running a generative model that refuses correction.

kos.name: ϰ — Draken invariant
kos.definition: *The invariant* is cohomological: discrete, preserved under the sheaf analogue of ambient isotopy.
kos.formula: $$\varkappa(\mathcal F):=[\omega]\in H^1(X,\mathcal F),\qquad b_1(\mathcal F):=\dim H^1(X,\mathcal F).$$

kos.name: ρ — restriction map
kos.definition: I kärv-teori beskriver restriktionsavbildningen ρ_U,V : F(U) → F(V) hur information över ett stort område (U) begränsas till ett mindre delområde (V ⊆ U).

kos.name: H¹ — cohomological obstruction
kos.definition: Tekniskt: ett icke-trivialt element i H¹(X, F) — den första kohomologigruppen av kärven F över rummet X.

kos.name: Care operator V̇_exo = 0
kos.definition: The care operator is the condition $\dot{\mathcal V}_{exo}=0$: the non-destruction of exogenous variety — the commitment not to annihilate the otherness of the thing you are bound to.

kos.name: Θ — trophic debt
kos.definition: Define trophic debt as the accumulated *violation* of care:

defined_in.section: §4 — Trophic debt: the bill for closing the loop

kos.name: Optimization axiom
kos.definition: "Minska oordningen i systemet — men inte genom att förenkla bort komplexiteten."

kos.name: Manufactured void
kos.definition: "När maktstrukturer medvetet skapar informationshål för att styra vilka berättelser som kan bildas."
kos.note: The Ordlista attributes the concept to The Manufactured Void (DRK-110); no single defining sentence was found in DRK-110 itself.

kos.name: Cavity_AI — cavity resonator
kos.definition: "En strukturerande tomhet som formar allt som passerar genom den."
kos.note: First used in The Curious Machine (DRK-115) with a different gloss ("complexity measure").

kos.name: Inversion filter (V.7)
kos.definition: Det viktigaste diagnostiska verktyget: om en struktur hävdar att den erbjuder global koherens men kräver informationsundertryckning vid sina gränser, är den en tillverkad tomhet — inte en genuin gräns.
kos.note: The Kaiju Manifesto (DRK-105) gives an operational form: accept(m) ⇔ cos_sim(m, C_draken) > cos_sim(m, C_parasitic) + ε.

kos.name: α — abstraction depth
kos.definition: We define *abstraction depth* as the number of representational layers between a claim to power and the capacity that underlies it:

defined_in.section: II. The Primate Who Learned to Abstract

kos.formula: **α = number of representational layers between signal and substance**

kos.name: Clinch
kos.definition: Horn, Gauldie, and King (1994) described five distinct phases: *Display*, where the animals inflate their bodies laterally, maximizing apparent size; *Encompassing*, where they circle each other, assessing geometry; *Clinch*, where they rear up on hind legs and lock forelimbs in bipedal wrestling; *Catch*, where one animal attempts to topple the other using what researchers have described as judo-like throws; and *Subpressive*, where the victor mounts the defeated animal in a dominance display.

defined_in.section: I. A Life Measured in Grapples

kos.name: Kayfabe
kos.definition: When the framework's diagnostic output flags Ψ → 1 with restriction maps collapsing — kayfabe, in the working vocabulary — what it has detected is a configuration that has become locally coherent at the cost of severing its accountability to the larger system.

kos.name: Survivable glitch
kos.definition: A failure mode whose information content survives the failure event, gets fed back into the design layer, and improves the protocol for the next iteration.

defined_in.section: III. The Survivable Glitch: Where Engineering Anticipated Philosophy

kos.definition: The first is **coordination**: the degree to which the group's neural activity is temporally aligned, phase-locked, beating together.

defined_in.section: 1. Two layers, never to be conflated

kos.name: Cargo
kos.definition: The second is **representational alignment**: the degree to which the group now holds the *same* belief, the same vector in some semantic space.

kos.definition: Fei Xiaotongs begrepp från 1947: kinesisk social struktur organiseras som koncentriska ringar runt individen — familj närmast, sedan släkt, sedan grannar, sedan samhälle — med moralisk förpliktelse som avtar med avstånd.

kos.name: Sheaf Laplacian
kos.definition: The sheaf Laplacian is $\Delta_{\mathcal{F}} = \delta^T \delta$, where $\delta$ is the coboundary operator measuring disagreement on edges.
kos.note: External term (Hansen & Ghrist 2019), adopted by the corpus.

kos.name: Global section
kos.definition: A *global section* is an assignment $\{x_v \in \mathcal{F}(v)\}_{v \in V}$ such that $\rho_{u \to e}(x_u) = \rho_{v \to e}(x_v)$ for every edge $e = (u,v) \in E$.
kos.note: Standard sheaf-theory term; the corpus also uses "glue/gluing" for the same condition.

kos.name: DRK-131 falsification protocol
kos.definition: The DRK-131 protocol exists precisely to discipline this risk: no fabricated citations, verified paraphrases, explicit falsification subsection, three-questions review.
kos.note: The protocol is named after DRK-131; this is the first sentence in the corpus that states its content.
